behaviour: A dried, fermented mix of wheat flour and yogurt with tomato, pepper and onion, crumbled or ground to a coarse powder and kept for the winter. Soaked in cold liquid and whisked smooth, it thickens a soup and gives it a sour, savoury depth. Dropped dry into hot liquid it forms lumps that do not soften.

contains.basis: It is made with wheat flour.
It is made with wheat flour.
Most tarhana is made with yogurt, though a few regional kinds are not.
